notes: Live Links Runtime Fix. Replaces the non-running Build086 pilot, whose Low Stock empty-state string contained a JavaScript quote syntax error that prevented the entire Live Links script from executing. Build087 restores tappable Home Inventory Summary cards using delegated click handling: Products opens Products, Total Inventory opens Inventory, Locations opens Warehouse Map, and Low Stock opens a read-only drill-down using the same Home thresholds. No inventory quantities, Cloud Master data, Receiving, Shipping, Return, Carpet Cutting, Ledger calculations, or database schema are changed.
